query: 2020, textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count,
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
  ) AS relevance
FROM Papers p
WHERE p.year = 2020
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%textattack%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%textattack%' OR
    (
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B')
    ) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack framework adversarial attacks data augmentation adversarial training nlp')
  )
ORDER BY relevance DESC, p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: 2016, emnlp, nanjing normal university, amr parsing with an incremental joint model
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue_type,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.year = 2016
  AND p.canonical_venue ILIKE 'EMNLP'
  AND i.display_name ILIKE '%nanjing normal university%'
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%amr%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%abstract meaning representation%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%incremental joint model%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%amr%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%abstract meaning representation%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%incremental joint model%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%amr parsing with an incremental joint model%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%amr%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%incremental joint model%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%amr%' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%incremental joint model%' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' OR p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machines%' THEN 3
     WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machines%' THEN 2
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%translation quality%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translation quality%' THEN 1
     ELSE 0
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: class prior estimation for learning from positive and unlabeled data, 2016, machine learning, m plessis, tokyo institute of technology
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.year,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id

  AND (

    OR (p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%positive%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%unlabeled%')
  )
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%machine learning%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%machine learning%'
    OR p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%machine learning%'
  )
  AND a.name ILIKE '%plessis%'
  AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%tokyo institute of technology%'
    OR i.display_name ILIKE '%Tokyo Inst%Tech%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%class prior estimation%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%positive and unlabeled%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior estimation%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE '%m%plessis%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%tokyo institute of technology%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%machine learning%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   LEAST(p.citation_count, 100) / 100.0
  ) DESC

query: a neural generative model for joint learning topics and topic specific word embeddings
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  ts_rank_cd(

    @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'neural generative model joint learning topics topic specific word embeddings')
ORDER BY relevance DESC
LIMIT 100
